description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead our clinical team at a premier health and rehabilitation center. This is an exceptional opportunity for a compassionate leader to make a significant impact on patient care and staff development. If you are passionate about fostering a supportive environment and ensuring the highest standards of nursing practice, we encourage you to apply.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be instrumental in overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring regulatory compliance, and driving continuous quality improvement initiatives. We are looking for a proactive individual who can inspire and guide our nursing staff while maintaining excellent patient outcomes. This role offers a competitive salary and the chance to join a facility committed to excellence.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Proven experience in a nursing leadership role, preferably as a Director of Nursing or Assistant Director of Nursing
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations for skilled nursing facilities
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills
Commitment to quality patient care and staff development
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary ranging from $85,000 to $95,000, based on experience and qualifications.
